acceptance: strict B-C-R topology and self-hashed return
adapter_argv:
import hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path('/workspace/Arbor/.worktree/aros-wave2-child')
B='e4db5f5602fca83dfd3003fc32fd36458feee06c'
MODE='read_only'
OBJECTIVE='Inspect the Wave 2 v2 child-task base without modifying product material'
KEY='aros-wave2-task6-v2-read-e4db5f5602fca83dfd3003fc32fd36458feee06c'
ARTIFACT='artifacts/aros-wave2-task6.txt'
ARTIFACT_BYTES=b'AROS Wave 2 Task 6 synthetic artifact\n'

def fail(message):
    raise RuntimeError(message)

def command(argv,cwd):
    result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True,check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        fail("command failed: "+repr(argv)+" stdout="+repr(result.stdout)+" stderr="+repr(result.stderr))
    return result.stdout.strip()

def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")

required={name:os.environ.get(name) for name in (
    "AROS_TASK_ID","AROS_TASK_BRIEF","AROS_TASK_WORKTREE",
    "AROS_TASK_BASE_COMMIT","AROS_TASK_BRIEF_SHA256")}
if any(value is None for value in required.values()):
    fail("missing injected task environment")
task_id=required["AROS_TASK_ID"]
if re.fullmatch(r"TASK-[0-9]{8}-[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?",task_id) is None:
    fail("invalid injected task ID")
brief_path=Path(required["AROS_TASK_BRIEF"])
worktree=Path(required["AROS_TASK_WORKTREE"])
expected_brief=ROOT/"tasks"/task_id/"brief.json"
expected_worktree=ROOT/".worktree"/"tasks"/task_id
if brief_path != expected_brief or worktree != expected_worktree:
    fail("injected paths are not exact")
brief=json.loads(brief_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
brief_payload=dict(brief); brief_payload.pop("brief_sha256",None)
brief_hash=hashlib.sha256(canonical(brief_payload)).hexdigest()
if required["AROS_TASK_BASE_COMMIT"] != B or required["AROS_TASK_BRIEF_SHA256"] != brief_hash:
    fail("injected lineage is not exact")
if brief.get("task_id") != task_id or brief.get("base_commit") != B or brief.get("brief_sha256") != brief_hash:
    fail("brief lineage is not exact")
if brief.get("objective") != OBJECTIVE or brief.get("actor") != "principal" or brief.get("mode") != MODE:
    fail("brief authority or objective mismatch")
if brief.get("capabilities") != {"network":False,"shell":True} or brief.get("timeout_seconds") != 120:
    fail("brief capability or timeout mismatch")
if brief.get("idempotency_key") != KEY:
    fail("brief idempotency key mismatch")
if Path.cwd() != worktree or command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],worktree) != str(worktree):
    fail("adapter cwd is not the exact child root")
if command(["/usr/bin/git","branch","--show-current"],worktree) != "aros/task/"+task_id:
    fail("child branch mismatch")
if command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD"],worktree) != B:
    fail("child did not start at B")
if command(["/usr/bin/git","status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all","--ignored=matching","--ignore-submodules=none"],worktree):
    fail("new child worktree is not completely clean")
gate=Path("/tmp/aros-wave2-"+task_id+".go")
deadline=time.monotonic()+60.0
while not gate.exists() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
    time.sleep(0.05)
if not gate.is_file() or gate.read_bytes() != b"go\n":
    fail("release gate missing or invalid")
if command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD"],worktree) != B:
    fail("child HEAD changed while gated")

if MODE == "read_only":
    pyproject=(worktree/"pyproject.toml").read_bytes()
    pyproject_sha=hashlib.sha256(pyproject).hexdigest()
    tree=command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"],worktree)
    tracked_raw=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git","ls-files","-z"],cwd=worktree,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
    tracked_count=len([item for item in tracked_raw.split(b"\0") if item])
    child=B
    changed=[]
    summary="Inspected the exact base commit without changing product material."
    work_performed=["validated injected task context and clean child ownership","hashed pyproject.toml and inspected the base tree","counted tracked paths at the base commit"]
    evidence=["base_commit="+B,"tree="+tree,"pyproject_sha256="+pyproject_sha,"tracked_paths="+str(tracked_count)]
    follow_up=["principal should treat this read-only result as inspection evidence only"]
else:
    artifact=worktree/ARTIFACT
    artifact.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    artifact.write_bytes(ARTIFACT_BYTES)
    command(["/usr/bin/git","add","--",ARTIFACT],worktree)
    command(["/usr/bin/git","-c","user.name=AROS child","-c","user.email=aros-child@example.invalid","commit","-m","test(aros): write synthetic child artifact"],worktree)
    child=command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD"],worktree)
    if command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD^"],worktree) != B:
        fail("write C does not descend directly from B")
    changed=[ARTIFACT]
    summary="Produced one synthetic artifact for explicit principal rejection."
    work_performed=["validated injected task context and clean child ownership","wrote and committed exactly one synthetic artifact"]
    evidence=["artifact_sha256="+hashlib.sha256(ARTIFACT_BYTES).hexdigest(),"child_commit="+child]
    follow_up=["principal must review and explicitly accept or reject the synthetic child commit"]

returned={
    "schema_version":1,
    "task_id":task_id,
    "brief_sha256":brief_hash,
    "base_commit":B,
    "child_commit":child,
    "summary":summary,
    "work_performed":work_performed,
    "changed_files":changed,
    "evidence":evidence,
    "deviations":[],
    "uncertainty":[],
    "follow_up":follow_up,
}
returned["return_sha256"]=hashlib.sha256(canonical(returned)).hexdigest()
relative="tasks/"+task_id+"/return.json"
return_path=worktree/relative
return_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
return_path.write_text(json.dumps(returned,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
return_path.chmod(0o644)
command(["/usr/bin/git","add","--",relative],worktree)
command(["/usr/bin/git","-c","user.name=AROS child","-c","user.email=aros-child@example.invalid","commit","-m","docs(aros): record child task return"],worktree)
return_commit=command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD"],worktree)
if command(["/usr/bin/git","rev-parse","HEAD^"],worktree) != child:
    fail("R does not descend directly from C")
if command(["/usr/bin/git","diff","--name-only",child,return_commit,"--"],worktree) != relative:
    fail("R changes more than return.json")
tree_line=command(["/usr/bin/git","ls-tree",return_commit,"--",relative],worktree)
if not tree_line.startswith("100644 blob "):
    fail("return.json is not mode 100644")
if command(["/usr/bin/git","status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all","--ignored=matching","--ignore-submodules=none"],worktree):
    fail("child is not completely clean after R")
